title: RAII Toolkit
hints: Every RAII class has the same shape: get the resource in the constructor, give it back in the destructor, delete the copy operations so two objects never own the same thing (lesson 7.04).
To make `File` movable, the move constructor takes the other object's `FILE*` and sets the other one to `nullptr`, and the destructor only calls `fclose` when the pointer is not null.
requirements: `IndentGuard` — increases a global log indentation level while alive
